job.question: In the Shrewsbury Contributory Retirement System RFP for investment consultant services, how long is the chosen consultant expected to be retained?
job.expected_facts: For five (5) years, not to exceed seven (7) years including any renewal, extension or option. The Board can terminate on thirty (30) days written notice.
job.acceptance: Five years and seven-year total ceiling including renewals/extensions/options. Thirty-day termination is optional.

reviews.reason: This is an Illinois Teachers’ Retirement System RFP, not the Shrewsbury Contributory Retirement System RFP. Its five-year sample agreement cannot establish Shrewsbury’s retention term; it also prohibits extensions rather than stating a seven-year total ceiling.
quotes: Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR INVESTMENT CONSULTING SERVICES

The Professional services under this Agreement shall be provided between date of execution and June 30, 2028 (not to exceed five years form the date of execution) unless earlier terminated in accordance with this Agreement.
The term of this Agreement may not be extended.
